notes.title: Speed Buff & Steam Inventory Items!
notes.content:
NEW: added steam inventory items, collect them by playing and get rewarded automatically for playing!
Collect them all and try to get all the buffs!
Items: 
1. Stick Figure, does nothing, for trading only!
2. Speed Buff, buff player speed by +1.0!
3. Health Buff, buff player health by +50HP!
4. Damage Buff, buff player damage by +1.0!

notes.title: Improved Controls Menu Text
notes.content:
Improved Controls Menu Text: Wrote some code to replace the "old" text in the controls menu with the updated code, as well as better align the buttons.

Have some plans for the future but they will be slow because I'm working on PROFOUND and a golf game as well as this. Plan to add lights to level editor eventually, with adjustable colors and intensity, ect. Plan to make some more levels, or perhaps a full campaign, but will come around to that later.
